perks.name: Regenerative Threshold
perks.description: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
perks.exact:
On Finisher:
Grants Regenerative Threshold.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Regenerative Threshold.
Restores 20 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

perks.name: Melee Conduction
perks.description: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
perks.exact:
While Cure, Radiant, or Restoration are active:
Melee and Glaive Hits trigger a Solar Burst on the target, dealing 28 [17] Damage and inflicting x20+10 Scorch within 7 meters.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown per trigger.
Will NOT trigger if the Melee Hit granted a Solar Buff, such as Ember of Torches, unless the Melee Ability intrinsically inflicts Scorch. (Exotics do NOT count)
